title.en: How to Get a SiliconFlow API Key (2026 Step-by-Step Tutorial)
title.zh: 如何获取硅基流动 API Key（2026 逐步教程）

excerpt.en: Register on siliconflow.cn, complete identity verification for free-model access, create your API key, and check the current ¥16 China / $1 global new-user offer.
excerpt.zh: 在 siliconflow.cn 注册、完成实名认证以使用全部免费模型、创建 API Key，并核对当前中国站 ¥16 / 国际站 $1 新用户活动。

en: You need a phone number for registration. Chinese +86 numbers work directly on siliconflow.cn; international users should use the global site at siliconflow.com. A payment method is not required to start — the [[guide:siliconflow-api-free-tier-2026|SiliconFlow free tier]] and bonus credits work without any top-up.

No prior experience with API keys is needed. This tutorial covers everything from account creation to your first successful API call. For a broader overview of the platform, [[guide:silicon-flow-api-key-complete-guide|the complete SiliconFlow guide]] covers models, pricing, and advanced configurations.
zh: 注册需要一个手机号。中国 +86 号码在 siliconflow.cn 直接使用；国际用户建议用全球站 siliconflow.com。开始时无需支付方式——[[guide:siliconflow-api-free-tier-2026|硅基流动免费层]]和赠送额度不充值即可使用。
不需要有 API Key 使用经验。本教程从注册账号到完成第一次 API 调用全程覆盖。如需更全面的平台概览，[[guide:silicon-flow-api-key-complete-guide|完整的硅基流动指南]] 涵盖了模型、定价和高级配置。

en: Go to siliconflow.cn (or siliconflow.com for international users) and follow the current registration flow. SiliconFlow's official June 2026 announcement states a ¥16 new-user credit on the China site or $1 on the global site; confirm that the campaign is still shown when you register.
Identity verification is required to use all free models. Free-model rate limits are fixed; verification should not be described as automatically increasing those fixed limits.
zh: 访问 siliconflow.cn（国际用户用 siliconflow.com），按页面当前流程完成注册。硅基流动 2026 年 6 月官方公告写明中国站新用户赠金为 ¥16、国际站为 $1；注册时请确认活动仍在展示。
使用全部免费模型需要实名认证。免费模型限额是固定的，因此不应把实名认证描述成会自动提升这些固定限额。

en: Click register, enter phone number and SMS code
Check whether the current ¥16 China / $1 global offer is available
zh: 访问 siliconflow.cn（中国）或 siliconflow.com（全球）
点击注册，输入手机号和短信验证码
核对当前中国站 ¥16 / 国际站 $1 活动是否可用

en: After logging in, go to Account Settings > Real-Name Verification. SiliconFlow requires ID verification to comply with Chinese regulations and to prevent abuse of the free tier. For Chinese users, this means submitting your identity card or passport. The verification is usually instant.
After verification, you can use all free models. Their rate limits remain fixed according to SiliconFlow's official documentation; inspect each model's live limit in the console.
zh: 登录后，进入「账号设置」>「实名认证」。硅基流动按中国法规要求身份认证，也是为了防止免费额度被滥用。中国用户需提交身份证或护照。认证通常即时完成。
实名认证后可以使用全部免费模型。根据硅基流动官方文档，免费模型限额仍是固定值；具体数值请在控制台查看。

en: Navigate to the API Keys page in the console dashboard (usually found under a menu item labeled API 密钥 or API Keys). Click Create New Key, give it a descriptive name like my-dev-project so you can identify it later, and click confirm.

The full key (starting with sk-) is displayed only once. Copy it immediately to a secure location — a password manager, a .env file in your project, or your server's environment variables. If you lose it, you will need to create a new key and update all your applications.
zh: 在控制台进入 API 密钥页面（菜单项通常叫「API 密钥」或「API Keys」）。点击「新建密钥」，给它一个描述性名称，如 my-dev-project，方便日后识别，然后确认。
完整 Key（以 sk- 开头）只显示一次。请立即复制到安全位置——密码管理器、项目的 .env 文件或服务器环境变量。如果丢失，需要新建 Key 并更新所有应用。

heading.en: Step 4: Make Your First API Call
heading.zh: 第四步：完成第一次 API 调用

en: With your key ready, you can call any model on the platform. To [[guide:silicon-flow-models-and-pricing|learn more about available models]] and their pricing, see our model comparison guide. Here is a minimal example using the free Qwen3-8B model and the OpenAI Python SDK. If you don't have the SDK installed, run pip install openai first.
zh: 拿到 Key 后就能调用平台上的任何模型。要[[guide:silicon-flow-models-and-pricing|了解更多可用模型]]及其定价，请参阅我们的模型对比指南。下面是一个使用免费 Qwen3-8B 模型和 OpenAI Python SDK 的最小示例。如果没装 SDK，先运行 pip install openai。

caption.en: First API call to the free Qwen3-8B model via SiliconFlow
caption.zh: 通过硅基流动第一次调用免费 Qwen3-8B 模型

en: If the SMS verification code does not arrive, wait 60 seconds and request a new one. International phone numbers may have delivery delays; the global site (siliconflow.com) tends to be more reliable for non-Chinese numbers.

If real-name verification fails, ensure the name on your ID exactly matches what you entered, and that the document photo is clear and unobstructed. Support can be reached through the in-console help button.

If your API call returns a 401 error, double-check that you copied the entire key including the sk- prefix, and that you are using the correct base URL. A 429 error means you hit the rate limit — wait a minute and retry, or check the complete guide for tier upgrade details. Once your key is working, you can explore [[guide:silicon-flow-byok-setup-guide|using your key in third-party tools]] like Cherry Studio and Claude Code.
zh: 如果短信验证码收不到，等 60 秒后重新获取。国际手机号可能有送达延迟；非中国号码用全球站（siliconflow.com）通常更可靠。
如果实名认证失败，确认证件上的姓名与填写完全一致，证件照片清晰无遮挡。可通过控制台内的帮助按钮联系客服。
如果 API 调用返回 401 错误，检查是否复制了完整的 Key（包括 sk- 前缀）以及 base URL 是否正确。429 错误表示触发限流——等一分钟重试，或查看完全指南了解等级升级详情。Key 调通后，你还可以探索[[guide:silicon-flow-byok-setup-guide|在第三方工具中使用你的 Key]]，如 Cherry Studio 和 Claude Code。

question.en: Do I need to pay to get a SiliconFlow API key?
question.zh: 获取硅基流动 API Key 需要付费吗？

answer.en: No. Registration and API key creation are free. SiliconFlow's current announcement states a ¥16 China-site or $1 global-site new-user credit, and models marked free on the live pricing page are billed at zero within fixed rate limits.
answer.zh: 不需要。注册和创建 API Key 免费。当前官方公告写明中国站新用户 ¥16、国际站 $1；实时价格页标记为免费的模型在固定限额内费用为 0。

question.en: Can I use SiliconFlow without real-name verification?
question.zh: 不做实名认证能用硅基流动吗？

answer.en: You can register and create a key, but SiliconFlow's official rate-limit documentation says identity verification is required to use all free models.
answer.zh: 可以先注册并创建 Key，但硅基流动官方限流文档说明，使用全部免费模型需要完成实名认证。
